title: Grand Rapids, MI — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Grand Rapids, MI: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Grand Rapids is a city in MI with a population of 198,917. Beer City USA with craft breweries, ArtPrize, and affordable Lake Michigan living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.1.
